description: Neo-Nazis launch a riot at the museum seminar, gunshots ring out, the crowd screams and scatters, supernatural forces of temporal collapse manifest, and the agents are forced to draw their weapons.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Since Gurevich went to the lounge, David checks what Manson is doing.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: After finishing a cocktail, Manson also entered the VIP lounge to rest. The clock pointed to 14:00. Those of you on the scene saw a host step onto the stage from backstage and gesture for quiet to the audience. The noisy venue gradually quieted down. "Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the final event of the exhibition 'From the Middle Ages to the Nazi Era: European Black Magic'—the grand debate brought to you by Mr. Max Manson and Professor George Gurevich! Please allow me to introduce our distinguished guest, Professor George Gurevich! He is from the University of Frankfurt and has extremely high achievements in the fields of psychology and neuroscience. His latest work, Human Consciousness, Human Self, Human Nerves, ah, sorry, that's not right..." The host clearly also struggled to pronounce the title of Gurevich's book correctly, his tongue nearly tied, but after some effort, he managed to say it: "—The Neural Activity of the Minimal Self in Humans, whew, okay. This work has sparked heated discussion in the scientific community... um, very heated discussion. Anyway, a very impressive scientist!" Next, the host spent over a minute introducing Manson's honorary titles and list of works, but even such lengthy and boring content stirred excitement among the fans in the audience. "...Additionally, Mr. Manson will also showcase his latest personal collection before the debate—a mystical manuscript from Siberian tribes, the Old World Black Book!"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew tries his best to join everyone in applauding and welcoming.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Oh oh oh oh oh!" Alison claps and cheers at this moment, pretending to be a fervent fan.

conversation.speaker: player2

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: At this moment, many people stand up cheering and clapping, blocking your line of sight. After the lengthy opening introductions conclude, the host announces the entrance of today's two debate guests. Gurevich and Manson emerge from the VIP lounge one after the other and, under the protection of a security cordon, walk onto the stage. Immediately, another wave of enthusiastic applause and cheers erupts from the audience.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Oh oh oh oh oh, cheering along.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You can see that both men are empty-handed as they step onto the stage, but in the blink of an eye, Manson is holding a delicate small briefcase, large enough to hold an ancient-style book.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Wow! That's amazing!

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Gray, having seen the promotional video, instantly understands that this is Manson's magic "Absolute Concealment." The audience, seeing this trick, excitedly applaud and cheer.

conversation.speaker: player5

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew is still vigorously applauding this magical scene.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David becomes alert. He prepares to shoot at the first sign of Gurevich making a move, though it probably won't be of much use.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Alison takes out the mirror, holding it in her hand and stroking it, ready to cast a spell at any moment.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Just as Gray is preparing to act in the audience, adapting to the slightly tense atmosphere, a sudden scream pierces the noise of the venue. Before you can react, you hear a heavy "Boom—" sound of metal impact, followed by a "Ding!" notification tone—like an elevator arriving.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: It seems Haddin has arrived.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The next second, a group of people dressed in old military uniforms floods out from the freight elevator entrance, shouting slogans like "Defend German History!" and "Make Germany Great Again!" These familiar yet grating slogans instantly make you recognize them: they are the neo-Nazis who have been holding signs and protesting at the museum entrance these past few days. But you didn't expect them to actually charge in, nor did you expect them to break into the scene so quickly and suddenly.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Alison turns to stare at the freight elevator entrance, then is startled by the scene.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David quickly looks at Manson, thinking, dude, did you put the book away?

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Although they guessed Haddin would use these people to charge in, they didn't expect them to get this close.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: They shove audience members and security guards like rioters, overturn chairs, and chaos spreads at an incredible speed. Roars, curses, collisions, and cries for help intertwine into a cacophony of harsh noise.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Good grief, impressive."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: While exchanging glances with colleagues, carefully and nonchalantly approach the stage, getting closer to the two important figures.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David screams along with the panicked audience while subtly retreating step by step, moving closer to the stage.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: At the center of the stage, Gurevich and Manson are clearly not mentally prepared for the sudden intrusion of rioters. They freeze at first, then instinctively take a few steps back, their faces showing a mix of awkwardness, confusion, and vigilance. Manson subconsciously grabs the microphone stand, while Gurevich turns sideways to look toward the backstage direction, as if waiting for something.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Alison quickly pretends to be frightened and avoids them, taking the opportunity to move closer to the stage direction.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: However, Andrew did not intend to do anything; he was still waiting.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Meanwhile, the security personnel reacted swiftly, seemingly having an emergency deployment plan. You see over a dozen guards in gray-black uniforms quickly approaching from different entrances. They do not charge into the crowd but skillfully form an interception line, semi-surrounding the neo-Nazis in the central area of the audience seats, attempting to contain the chaos within a narrow range.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Behind the scenes? David, pay attention to behind the scenes. Could there be accomplices planning to ambush Manson?

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: But a new problem arises: as the security line advances, the front rows of the audience area suddenly become empty, with no security barriers left between the stage and the commotion—If someone wanted to quietly approach the stage and get close to the target at this moment, there would no longer be any physical restrictions!

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: What time is it now? Where's Haddin? It's already chaos here; he can come and take advantage of the situation.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Alison looks up to check the lighting situation. How many lights are there in total?

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David remains vigilant against Govich, who might try something sneaky.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: As the security personnel's human wall begins to engage with the neo-Nazis, all the lights on the second floor suddenly go out, plunging the scene into darkness.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Was the black book still in Manson's hands before the lights went out?

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Watch out, Mr. Manson!" Alison raises her voice, pretending to be a fanatic fan to warn him.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David quickly recalls and takes advantage of the darkness to find a suitable combat position.

conversation.speaker: player6

conversation.speaker: player5

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Protect Mr. Manson!" David shouts along.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: However, this causes even greater chaos in the darkness. The crowd begins to push and shove; it seems someone has been knocked down, with loud cursing. A stampede accident may be about to occur. Meanwhile, you are plunged into pitch-black darkness, and your eyes have not yet adapted to the low-light environment.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Find a safe spot; be careful not to get knocked over.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: However, on the stage, a clump of green fluorescence floats in the air, becoming the most conspicuous marker in the darkness.

conversation.speaker: player4

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: There's no time to worry about that now; David moves toward that clump of fluorescence.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: What is that? Andrew is at a loss. But it seems everyone is moving toward it? Then Andrew will do the same.

conversation.speaker: player4

conversation.speaker: player2

conversation.speaker: player5

conversation.speaker: player3

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Although not knowing what that green fluorescence is, David also takes advantage of the chaos to run off with his accomplices.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Alison also pulls the pin on her smoke grenade and throws it on the ground, then fires a few shots into the air, taking advantage of the chaos to regroup with her teammates.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Damn it, stop those bastards!" Someone in the crowd turns on a flashlight; the temporary light helps them locate their targets.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Retreat, retreat, retreat. If not now, when?

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: But your gunshots cause the entire crowd to scream; they frantically surge toward the exit.
